Commit: **`cf99a8c6`**

**New cases (5), all red:**

| Test | Red reason |
|------|------------|
| `test_rebuild_secret_file_not_in_lexical_index` | `_preseed_lexical` inserts the secret file directly; `search(root, secret, refresh=False)` returns 1 hit from `secret_holder.py` |
| `test_rebuild_lexical_digest_matches_owner_refresh` | digest after rebuild differs from digest after the owner's `refresh` alone — rebuild indexes the secret file, refresh filters it out |
| `test_rebuild_stores_hold_no_secret` | `stores_with_secrets(root)` finds the secret in `.gov-runtime/store.db` — the W1-15 secrets-indexing backstop fails |
| `test_rebuild_codeintel_reason_is_measured` | reason is the hardcoded constant `"no code index module exists"` but `src/gov/codeintel/__init__.py` exists with `index(root)` |
| `test_rebuild_codeintel_is_recreated_when_tool_answers` | status is `"not_recreated"` despite `codebase-memory-mcp` being on PATH; rebuild never calls `codeintel.index` |

**Counts:** 5 new failed, 69 earlier passed, 3 pre-existing failures unchanged. Total W1-27 tests: 69 (63 new + 6 revised W1-07).

**Nothing unsettled.** W1-16 offers `gov.codeintel.index(root)` (`src/gov/codeintel/__init__.py:98`) which builds or refreshes the code index; it needs `codebase-memory-mcp` on PATH. Both states (tool answers, tool absent) have a case.
